sourceChanges.citationTitle: Anbar Journal of Agricultural Sciences - Artificial Intelligence (AI) Usage and Disclosure Policy
Journal Policy on the Use of Artificial Intelligence

claimChanges.claimText: The Anbar Journal of Agricultural Sciences requires manuscript AI-use disclosure at submission and bars reviewers from using AI tools to generate review reports while stating that editors must not rely on AI for editorial decisions.

The Anbar Journal of Agricultural Sciences prohibits AI use for generating scientific content without human verification, fabricating or manipulating data, obscuring authorship responsibility, or listing AI tools as co-authors.
The University of Anbar Journal of Languages and Literature requires authors to explicitly disclose AI-tool use in the Acknowledgment or Methodology section, including the tool, version, and purpose.

The University of Anbar Journal of Languages and Literature permits reliable AI tools only for supportive purposes such as proofreading, formatting, and scientifically verifiable linguistic or textual analysis.
